description: Generate a slide-deck-quality org chart: a tree of people cards (name, role, initials circle) joined by elbow connectors, top-down or left-right. Colour is automatic: each team under the root (each of the root's direct reports and everyone below them) gets its own palette colour; set `color` on a card only to override that. Choose it whenever the point is WHO reports to or works with whom: reporting lines, project or engagement teams, governance and steering structures. Use a mind map instead for ideas or topics radiating from a central theme, and a hub and spoke for one centre with peers around it. Nest people in `children` under `root`; more than 4 reports with no reports of their own are stacked in a column automatically. Limits: 60 people, 5 levels. Infer missing details rather than asking; the user can adjust the chart in the builder through the Edit link. ALWAYS give the user the image link: inline chat images usually cannot be saved, but the link renders the exact chart on demand and can be pasted into a slide or Markdown.

node.description: One person (or team) card. Children are the people who report to them.

children.description: Direct reports, left to right (top to bottom in left-right layout). More than 4 reports that have no reports of their own are stacked in a column under their manager to keep the chart compact.

color.description: Optional hex colour for this card's top stripe and initials, and for everyone below it, e.g. "#10b981". Without one, colour is automatic: the root takes the first palette colour, each of the root's direct reports takes the next one, and everyone below inherits their team's colour.

name.description: Person or team name, e.g. "Dana Lee" or "Two engineers". Shown bold on the card; the initials circle is made from it. Long names shrink, then truncate with an ellipsis.

role.description: Optional job title or responsibility, e.g. "Engagement lead". Wraps to two lines, then truncates.

inputSchema.description: An org chart: a reporting or project-team tree of people cards joined by elbow connectors.

credit.description: Shows a small "twominutetoolkit.com" credit under the chart, inside the card. Set false to leave it off (for example when the user asks for no branding).

layout.description: "top-down" (default): the root at the top, reports in rows below. "left-right": the root on the left, reports in columns to the right, which suits deep or very wide trees.

palette.description: Hex colours applied in order to items that have no colour of their own. Pass the user's brand colours here when they name them. Default: indigo, sky, emerald, amber, red, gray.

root.description: The top of the tree (the lead, manager or sponsor) with everyone else nested under it in `children`. Limits: 60 people and 5 levels in total (the root is level 1); extra people are dropped with a warning, deepest levels and last-listed people first.

showInitials.description: Show an initials circle on each card, in the card's team colour. Default true. There are no photos.

title.description: Heading shown top-left of the chart at 22px bold. Every chart has one title row; an empty string hides it.

width.description: Chart width in pixels (640–2400). Omit it (recommended) and the chart sizes itself to its content with comfortable margins, between 880 and 1280px wide. PNG output renders at 2x.

inputSchema.title: Org Chart
